question: When was the 3rd edition of the Khelo India Winter Games held in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Wed Feb 01 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khelo India Winter Games** is a part of the Government of India's initiative to promote **sports culture** in the country.
 
• The **3rd edition** of the Khelo India Winter Games was held in **Gulmarg, Jammu & Kashmir**, from **February 10–14, 2023**.
 
• This event was organized by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, in collaboration with the **Jammu and Kashmir Sports Council** and the **Winter Games Association of Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• The games aimed at promoting **winter sports** such as **skiing, snowboarding, ice hockey, and mountaineering** while encouraging participation from athletes across India.
 
• This edition witnessed participation from **over 1500 athletes** from across the country.
 
• The event aligns with the Government's vision under the **Khelo India Scheme** to identify and nurture talented athletes and promote sports infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Khelo India__

 
 
• Khelo India Youth Games is a National Programme for Development of Sports.
 
• It aims to improve sports at a young age and identify talent.
 
• It is held in January or February for two categories such as
 
• Under-17 years school students
 
• Under-21 college students
 
• The organisation is headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated it.
